definition.text: Dandruff is a skin condition that causes white or yellow skin flakes on your scalp. It may be itchy and spread to your hairline, eyebrows, and behind your ears. Dandruff is a milder form of seborrheic dermatitis (pronounced seb-or-ray-ic dur-muh-ty-tis) that happens just on your head. Seborrheic dermatitis is a common skin condition that causes itchy patches and greasy scales on your skin where you have a lot of oil (also called sebaceous) glands, including your scalp.
